scenarios.requirement: Every kind of program the editor starts holds 0, 1 and 2 and what its io kind names (the program's side of a debugger's pty), none of the descriptors the editor inherited
A debugger's program keeps the side of the pty named to it: the same device, still a terminal, and never the editor's master
A descriptor left open above the soft descriptor limit is closed in the child too: the close loop reaches the hard limit, not the soft one
The descriptor-by-descriptor close loop (macOS) gives rows 01-03 the same answers and prints what the close step cost
